**Observation Log:**

[TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/05/22 (Mon) 23:02  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] It is possible to design a system without the momentary pause using a flow-based pressure sensing mechanism.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] A flow restrictor can be installed in the air passage between the compressor and the tire to create a pressure drop.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The pressure sensor can be mechanical (e.g., Bourdon tube, diaphragm) or electronic (e.g., piezoelectric, strain gauge).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The user can set the desired tire pressure using a dial or a digital interface.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] A pressure-sensitive valve or solenoid valve can be connected to the pressure sensor.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The valve remains closed during the tire inflation process.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] When the tire pressure reaches the desired value, the pressure sensor sends a signal to the valve, causing it to open.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The valve deactivates once the pressure inside the tire drops slightly below the desired pressure.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] This design maintains the desired tire pressure and prevents overinflation.  
[USER] Asked how to make step 5 mechanical rather than electronic.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] A mechanical pressure switch or spring-loaded valve can replace the electronic pressure sensor and solenoid valve.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The user can set the desired tire pressure using a dial or an adjustable spring tension mechanism.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The mechanical pressure switch or spring-loaded valve will open due to increased pressure when the desired value is reached.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The valve will close once the pressure inside the tire drops slightly below the desired pressure.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] A mechanical pressure-sensitive valve activation mechanism can be a simple, cost-effective, and robust alternative to an electronic system.  
[USER] Asked how to make "the pressure sensor sends a signal to the pressure-sensitive valve or solenoid valve, causing it to open" mechanical rather than electronic.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] A spring-loaded valve can be directly connected to a pressure release valve to create a mechanical activation mechanism.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The spring-loaded valve will act as a mechanical pressure sensor, while the pressure release valve will control the release of excess air.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The user would set the desired tire pressure using a dial or an adjustable spring tension mechanism.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The spring-loaded valve will open due to increased pressure, mechanically actuating the connected pressure release valve.
